claims.identified: Bulbapedia Rarity: "For all sets in Generation V (from Black and White to Legendary Treasures), the holofoil pattern is named "Tinsel Holofoil", and consists of horizontal stripes across the image."

refused.claim: Bulbapedia Rarity: "Tinsel Holofoil returned as a once-off in Black Bolt and White Flare, with holofoil rare cards in these sets also having Tinsel Holofoil borders."
refused.conflict: The Black Bolt & White Flare set page marks Tinsel Holofoil on three cards only — 001, 011 and 021 — each a Black Bolt & White Flare Poster Collection exclusive, and TCGdex registers exactly those three variants as tinsel. Those are promotional printings this catalogue does not carry.
refused.decision: Neither set is painted: the sources disagree on whether every holo rare or only three promos carry it, and the sentence that does cover the holo rares describes a BORDER, which is a different foil area from the striped image reproduced here.

claims.promos: Bulbapedia says Tinsel was also used "along with various promotional cards", but names none of them, and this catalogue does not resolve promos by set. No promotional printing makes a Tinsel claim here.
